mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO demand_watch (workspace_id, demand_id, user_id, added_by) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{demandId}, #{userId}, #{addedBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM demand_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand_watch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId} AND user_id = #{userId}
